clocks.frameMetrics: raw token identity only; public Vsync is MONOTONIC, never compared to BOOTTIME

matrix.order: even round refresh-return; odd round return-refresh

attempt.revision: exact final EMULATOR_FED revision; record but do not qualify other revisions
attempt.uiIdentity: entire callback timestamp lies inside exactly one complete main-thread Choreographer#doFrame token span

submission.identity: same token in exactly one RT DrawFrames task; one setFrameTimelineInfo mapping for expected VRI queue and frameNumber; same frameNumber in nested BLAST acquireNextBufferLocked; swap and Drawing spans; one is_buffer=true SurfaceFrame
submission.endpoint: bufferEvidenceNs=BLAST acquireNextBufferLocked trace begin, a named evidence point, not physical visibility or exact driver queue insertion
submission.noSubmission: complete RT task contains syncFrameState but no Drawing/mapping/acquire/swap and no matching SurfaceFrame
submission.selection: earliest qualified attempt having its own complete submission evidence; never attach later RT-only work to an earlier attempt

presentation.identity: submitted attempt's exact PID/token SurfaceFrame cookie end and exact display_frame_token DisplayFrame cookie end
presentation.endpoint: DisplayFrame end in BOOTTIME, system composition endpoint, not photon time or first visible text
